## Study design and the reasons for a twenty-four week follow-up of the cohort

The cohort follows adults for twenty-four weeks.
Each site recruits its own participants.

### Eligibility

Adults aged eighteen or more are eligible.

#### Inclusion criteria with a long title that wraps over more than one line in the contents

Participants give written consent.

#### Exclusion criteria

Participants in another trial are not eligible.

### Recruitment

Sites recruit over twelve weeks.
